root_cause_analysis.issue: Windows file lock conflict ([WinError 32]) during corrupt database auto-recovery
root_cause_analysis.mechanism: sqlite3.Connection object was not explicitly closed when PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL or table DDL failed during database initialization. The open OS file handle prevented os.replace() from isolating the corrupted database.

remediation_implemented.connection_factory: try...except block in _get_connection() invokes conn.close() on any pragma error
remediation_implemented.init_db_lifecycle: Explicit conn.close() and gc.collect() in except block prior to self.db_path.replace(corrupt_backup)

fail_closed_compliance.requirement: If complete idempotency history cannot be established, broker must fail closed.
fail_closed_compliance.condition_1_state_exists: If state file exists with historical trades, clean DB is built and history is repopulated via sync_historical_keys(). Verified PASS.
fail_closed_compliance.condition_2_state_lost: If state file is missing or has zero history, broker raises IdempotencyRegistryError and fails closed. Verified PASS.
